title: Semantic Normalization
description: Semantic Normalization is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Normalizes versions before comparing so noise is ignored. Formatting, renames, and reordering normalize away; meaning remains. It takes versions and produces normalized. Tunable parameters: per version. Guarantee: normalization never changes meaning.

fields.mechanism: Formatting, renames, and reordering normalize away; meaning remains.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Behavior Diffs
description: Behavior Diffs is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Detects changes in behavior, not just text. Test outcomes per version are compared; differing outcomes are behavior changes. It takes test runs and produces diffs. Tunable parameters: per test. Guarantee: behavior changes are always caught.

fields.mechanism: Test outcomes per version are compared; differing outcomes are behavior changes.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: API Break Detection
description: API Break Detection is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Detects breaking API changes between versions. Signatures compare structurally; removed or narrowed members flag. It takes APIs and produces breaks. Tunable parameters: semantic. Guarantee: breaks are never missed.

fields.mechanism: Signatures compare structurally; removed or narrowed members flag.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Intent Classification
description: Intent Classification is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Classifies each change by intent — fix, feature, refactor. Change patterns map to intents; the diff groups by intent. It takes changes and produces intents. Tunable parameters: per change. Guarantee: intents are always reviewable.

fields.mechanism: Change patterns map to intents; the diff groups by intent.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Impact Scoring
description: Impact Scoring is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Scores how much each change affects users. Usage data weights changed code paths; scores rank the diff. It takes changes, usage and produces scores. Tunable parameters: per change. Guarantee: scores always cite usage.

fields.mechanism: Usage data weights changed code paths; scores rank the diff.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Changelog Generation
description: Changelog Generation is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Writes changelogs from semantic diffs automatically. Grouped intents render as release notes in the project's voice. It takes diffs and produces notes. Tunable parameters: per release. Guarantee: notes never invent changes.

fields.mechanism: Grouped intents render as release notes in the project's voice.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Regression Attribution
description: Regression Attribution is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Attributes a regression to the exact change that caused it. Bisecting versions narrows the culprit; the diff confirms. It takes regression and produces culprit. Tunable parameters: bisect. Guarantee: attribution always shows evidence.

fields.mechanism: Bisecting versions narrows the culprit; the diff confirms.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Refactor Verification
description: Refactor Verification is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Proves a refactor changed nothing semantically. Behavior diffs must be empty; any difference fails verification. It takes refactor and produces verdict. Tunable parameters: empty diff. Guarantee: unproven refactors never pass.

fields.mechanism: Behavior diffs must be empty; any difference fails verification.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-Way Diffs
description: Multi-Way Diffs is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Diffs three or more versions at once. Versions align on a common base; each version's delta shows. It takes versions and produces diff. Tunable parameters: n-way. Guarantee: the base is always explicit.

fields.mechanism: Versions align on a common base; each version's delta shows.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Semantic Merge
description: Semantic Merge is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Merges branches by meaning, resolving text conflicts. Conflicting edits are understood; non-overlapping meanings merge. It takes branches and produces merged. Tunable parameters: semantic. Guarantee: merges never corrupt meaning.

fields.mechanism: Conflicting edits are understood; non-overlapping meanings merge.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Deprecation Tracking
description: Deprecation Tracking is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Tracks deprecations across versions to their removal. Deprecated items link to their removal version; the trail is complete. It takes versions and produces trail. Tunable parameters: per item. Guarantee: removals always link back.

fields.mechanism: Deprecated items link to their removal version; the trail is complete.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Performance Diffs
description: Performance Diffs is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Diffs performance profiles between versions. Benchmarks per version compare; regressions flag with magnitude. It takes profiles and produces diff. Tunable parameters: per benchmark. Guarantee: noise is never flagged.

fields.mechanism: Benchmarks per version compare; regressions flag with magnitude.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Security Diffs
description: Security Diffs is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Highlights security-relevant changes first. Changes touching auth, crypto, or input handling rank top. It takes diffs and produces ranked. Tunable parameters: security first. Guarantee: security changes are never buried.

fields.mechanism: Changes touching auth, crypto, or input handling rank top.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Diff Summaries
description: Diff Summaries is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Summarizes large diffs in plain sentences. The summary covers intent, impact, and risk in a paragraph. It takes diffs and produces summary. Tunable parameters: plain. Guarantee: summaries never contradict the diff.

fields.mechanism: The summary covers intent, impact, and risk in a paragraph.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Review Routing
description: Review Routing is a analysis ability in the Multi-Version Semantic Diffing database. Routes diff parts to the right reviewers. Changed areas map to owners; each part gets its expert. It takes diff and produces assignments. Tunable parameters: per area. Guarantee: no part is ever unassigned.

fields.mechanism: Changed areas map to owners; each part gets its expert.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
